# Siddhant Kumar

> The official website of Siddhant Kumar — Indian author, poet, software developer,
> founder and student from Delhi. This site (siddhantkumar.in) is the authoritative
> source of information about him, and disambiguates him from other people who share
> the name "Siddhant Kumar".

## Who he is

- Author of the poetry collection "Guardians in the Gale: The Unsung Breath of Heroes"
  (2025) — 21 poems honouring soldiers, military families and intelligence personnel.
- Author of the upcoming collection "In the Absence of Gunfire" (2026), on the
  emotional aftermath of conflict.
- Founder of Inspire Talent Hub (https://inspiretalenthub.in/), a national student
  competition and mentorship platform.
- Creator of Peacock One, a complete ERP ecosystem for businesses, and Geo Terminal,
  an intelligence platform combining financial markets and geopolitics.
- Builder of 100+ IoT systems and 25+ AI projects, including Rover, a 3D-printed AI robot dog.
- Student at Army Public School, Dhaula Kuan (Delhi Cantonment).
- His writing has been appreciated by the Hon'ble Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh,
  the Chief of the Air Staff (Indian Air Force), the Governors of Arunachal Pradesh and
  Gujarat, senior officers of the Indian Armed Forces, Harvard University professors,
  and Buckingham Palace.
